test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The boy tried to complete the task on time because he **__didn’t want to miss farther tasks.__**

options.text: doesn’t want to miss farther tasks
didn’t want of miss farther tasks
doesn’t want to miss further tasks
didn’t want to miss further tasks

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in past tense, requiring **"didn't want"** to fit grammatically.
 
• **"Further tasks"** is the correct phrase to indicate **more tasks in the future.**
 
• **"farther"** which typically refers **to physical distance**.
 
 
• **Example**: The park is farther than I thought.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is- ***The boy tried to complete the task on time because he **didn’t want to miss further tasks*__*."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** uses present tense "doesn’t want,"** **which does not match the past tense context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2** is incorrect both grammatically ("didn’t want of miss") and in word choice ("farther").
 
• **Option 3** has the correct term "further tasks" but uses present tense "doesn’t want," mismatching the tense of the main sentence.
